# Session handoff template

- Updated date/timezone, branch, source commit and working-tree state:
- Human objective and latest scope/skip decisions:
- Selected ticket and acceptance path:
- What changed and why:
- Actual verification commands/results:
- Live evidence versus synthetic/mocked checks:
- Deployment/build/revision and rollback if changed:
- Remaining failure or uncertainty, exact normalized error and relevant path:
- Next ready action (file/command/test), not a vague continuation request:
- Required human input, only if still necessary; do not re-ask skipped setup:
- Docs/backlog/ADR changes:

Do not include credentials, cookies, raw personal conversation/media or private account details. Link to bounded redacted evidence instead.
